notes: Refined from the naive draft (3890 candidate entries, 3668 flagged FUZZY MATCH) by cross-checking every AMBIGUOUS/FUZZY candidate against surrounding transcript context, following the same methodology as episode 28. This episode is a wide-ranging retrospective/AMA-style episode, so unlike ep.28 the ambiguous shared first names do NOT all resolve to a single person -- both candidates are genuinely discussed and each occurrence was checked individually: 'Hanna'/'Hania'/'Hanny'/'Hanie' forms split between Hanna Koczewska (id 4) and Hanna Zagulska (id 10) depending on the sentence (resolved via same-line or multi-line surname context in each case); 'Krzysztof' = Krzysztof Gonciarz (id 1) in every case found (self-referential narration), while 'Krzysztof Stanowski' and 'Krzysztof Adamczyk' did not otherwise appear; 'Robert' = Robert Fidura (id 45); 'Maja' = Maja Staśko (id 40); 'Ewa' (one occurrence) resolved to Ewa Wyczółkowska (id 13) based on the same conversation containing three explicit 'Wyczółkowska' mentions nearby; 'Karolina' at [32:35] resolved to Karolina Korwin Piotrowska (id 90) via the explicit surname split across two lines. One low-confidence ambiguous case remains flagged in-line: bare 'Gretkowska' at [02:53:02] could be Manuela Gretkowska (id 14) or her daughter Pola Gretkowska (id 15); assigned to Manuela as the more prominent public figure.
